question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"benefactors."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Benefactors"** means people who give financial or other types of support to a person or organization. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या संस्‍था की सहायता, जैसे आर्थिक सहायता, प्रदान करने वाला व्‍यक्ति; दानी, उपकारी, परोपकारी)

 
 
• **Example**: *The local business owners were generous benefactors__ of the community center, donating money and supplies to help it thrive.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because it fits grammatically and makes sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

The oldest hub of carpet weaving in India is Mirzapur in Bhadohi district of Uttar Pradesh. The Ganga ______ (1) ______ past this town with its ghats, ancient temples and waterfalls. The genesis of carpet making in Mirzapur can be ______ (2) _______ to the Mughal emperor, Akbar, in the 16th century. A ______ (3) ______ of Persian carpet weavers, it is said, on its way to the Mughal court was __waylaid__ and injured by dacoits on the Grand Trunk Road. The weavers were rescued and given shelter by local villagers. The master weaver of the group decided to settle down here and share his skills with his __**benefactors**__. That is how the renowned carpet industry of Mirzapur took root.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2, "beneficiaries"**, refers to people who receive benefits or advantages from something. (विशेषतः किसी की मृत्‍यु के बाद धन या संपत्ति प्राप्‍त करने वाला व्‍यक्ति; हिताधिकारी, लाभग्राही)
 
• **Option 3, "recipients"**, also refers to people who receive something. (कुछ प्राप्‍त करने वाला व्‍यक्ति; प्राप्‍तकर्ता)
 
• **Option 4, "sponsors"**, refers to people or organizations that provide financial support for an event or activity. (विशेष खेल स्‍पर्धा आदि के लिए विज्ञापन-प्रदर्शन की सुविधा के साथ आर्थिक सहयोग करने वाला व्‍यक्ति या संस्‍था; प्रायोजक (व्‍यक्ति या संस्‍था))
